content.short: Vera enables NFT holders to earn by renting out their collections and by listing NFTs for access to events.
content.description: Vera is an NFT ecosystem that lets holders earn by renting out their collections. Collectors can list their NFTs to generate rental income for willing community members to lease. Users can access events and activities by renting special access NFTs - experiences they would miss without the assets. Vera expands NFT utility by turning ownership into a monetization opportunity and enabling broader participation through access provided by these assets.
content.meta: Vera is an NFT ecosystem enabling holders to earn by renting out their collections. Discover Vera and other NFT Dapps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
